The bundled checker replays the derivative bracket and numerical specialization; finite computation is not used as the all-parameter proof.

The result supplies the exact minimizer structure for the entire faithful qubit/projector-reward class and turns that benchmark from a black-box numerical optimization into a reproducible one-dimensional formula.
